name: Miracles Today
overview: Scripture reveals that miracles are a divine demonstration of God's power, affirming that what is impossible for man is possible with God, as Jesus taught in Matthew 19:26 and Luke 18:27. The miracles performed by Jesus and His followers confirm the truth of the gospel and authenticate their ministry, with God working alongside them to confirm His word through signs (Mark 16:20; John 3:2). Faith is essential to experiencing these miracles, as Jesus emphasized in Mark 9:23, where belief enables the possibility of all things. Despite human doubt expressed in Isaiah 53:1, the arm of the Lord continues to be revealed through miraculous works today.
